title: Karora Singh Strengthens the Misl and Baghel Singh Succeeds

blocks.text: This page describes the misl's rise under Karora Singh, whose leadership turns it into one of the more formidable bodies in the Dal Khalsa. Expelled or drifting Singhs from elsewhere are welcomed in, and the organization gains both manpower and prestige under that broad policy.

The narrative then records a decisive break in succession. At Tarauri did Karora Singh die while moving in the direction of Delhi, and leadership passes onward to Baghel Singh Dhaliwal as the misl holds together through the transition.

What matters most in the editorial logic of the page is continuity of strength. The misl survives bereavement, keeps its Majha base, and emerges ready for the next phase of Baghel Singh's military prominence.
